title: Hot Oatmeal Bowl

caption:
Hot Oatmeal Bowl 
breakfast | winter breakfast | vegan | oatmeal 

Nutrition: 
C: 80 | F: 15 | P: 12
Calories: 492 per serve 
Makes 1 serving

Ingredients
50 grams rolled oats ( keep in mind that 50 grams of oats is very filling, you can reduce this to 34-40 grams and reduce calories too ) 
100 grams milk ( use any you prefer almond, oat, lactose free or regular ) 
100 grams water
1/2 tsp cinnamon powder
1 tsp jaggery powder

toppings: 
one banana
one piece dark chocolate
1 tsp peanut butter

Method
add milk + water to a pot and bring to a mild simmer then add in the oats 
let them cook for 10-15 minutes, the final texture will be depend on how you want it, if you want a little bite to the oats or super mushy ( thats how i like it ) 
add in the cinnamon powder and jaggery to taste as much or as little as you like
take off the heat and top with sliced banana, a piece of dark chocoate and peanut butter and dig in!!
